title: Puharich letter admits Israeli-US mind control program at Aberdeen Proving Grounds

tellings.quote: he, um, basically admitted to being part of a Israeli US, um, mind con, you know, mind control program that was happening at Aberdeen Proving Grounds,

plain: Andrija Puharich, a scientist who studied psychic abilities, admitted in a letter to his bookkeeper and confidant that he took part in a joint Israeli and American mind control program at Aberdeen Proving Grounds, an Army testing site in Maryland. The researcher Greg Malatzi sums up the letter on the show without quoting it. If true, it would place Puharich inside a secret government program.
